name: web_search
description: Search the web for information. Returns relevant results with titles, URLs and snippets.

backend.description: Optional search backend id; omit to use the configured aggregation

freshness.description: Optional recency filter forwarded to backends that support filtering

language.description: Optional language code forwarded to backends that support filtering

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

region.description: Optional region code forwarded to backends that support filtering
